judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: The link "clique aqui." (to aplicacao.mpmg.mp.br/ouvidoria/service/cidadao/consulta) sits in a list item that reads "Consulta ao andamento da manifestação: clique aqui.", under the h2 "Atendimento da Ouvidoria do MPMG". claimTrue is no: the same list item, which the packet itself gives as the ancestor's name, says what the link is for, so it is not true that nothing around it does. elementFails is no: link text plus its list-item context (programmatically determined link context, G53/H77-style) identifies the purpose, checking the status of a submitted complaint, which matches the destination. It does not share its name and context with another link (the neighbouring "clique aqui" is in a different list item, labelled "Registro de manifestações e denúncias on line"), so R1 does not apply. captureDiffers is no: the live HTML fetched now has the same list item, link text and href, and the screenshot is fully styled. Rampa had the list item in its context and still judged it wrong.
